subject: project:gdl
value: WHAT THE NEW RETRIEVAL SURFACES ACTUALLY MEASURE ON THE MERGED 2026-09-01 CORPUS, taken from live runs rather than from design intent. (1) THE SLUG-INDEX GAP IS REAL AND WAS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. `laws --query "live zero remat"` returns claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source.20260831.v1 with match=['slug'] and NOT 'text' — the match provenance field proves the law's prose contains none of the queried words, so the previous prose-and-substring-only index returned exactly nothing for the family name typed as separate words. This is the RC/MB criticism reproduced as a passing measurement. (2) PIN MECHANISM PROSE WAS ENTIRELY UNREACHABLE AND IS NOW INDEXED: config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json carries 131 rules of which 82 have `mechanism` derivations; `laws --query permutation` surfaces 44 of them. These notes cite attempt and law record ids and are the densest description of a closed residual class in the project, but no query surface read that file before. (3) THE CAPABILITY GAP: `find --capability dataflow-equivalence` returns 14 records including attempt.WF_initcontrols-value-equality-close.20260901.v1 — the record the WF lane cited as naming its unpark capability with nothing able to query it. All 14 are match=prose today because the corpus predates the structured field; they are candidates, not a screen, and are labelled as such. (4) SIGNATURE TOKENISATION IS THE PRECISION-CRITICAL PART AND WAS WRONG BEFORE MEASUREMENT. 624 of BF's 971 signatures came from live fndiff sweeps in the format 'DIFFERS target-only: +1 add ours-only: -1 mr; insns T71/O71; 6 ops clusters'. Naive word-splitting yields {differs, target, only, ours, insns, ops, clusters, t71, o71}, so ANY two signatures overlap on framing vocabulary and the facet degenerates to noise. Reading only the mnemonics carried by a +N/-N marker fixes it: `laws --residual` on the real format now returns 282 sibling records whose shared-token sets are clean — 154 sharing {addi}, 103 sharing {addi, li}, 25 sharing {li}. (5) THE FAMILY FACET MUST BE READ AS THREE TIERS, NEVER TOTALLED. On live-zero-remat the verified `family` tier holds 2 records; the quarantined `family_candidate` tier adds 6 and only with --include-candidates; the legacy residual_class widening adds 298. A reader who totals these gets 306 and believes the family is the largest in the corpus, when the measured, verified population is 2. THE PIN PROVENANCE CENSUS, the finding most likely to be actionable: on game/game/controls.c, 5 of 6 webfrank pins classify `parked-without-probed_form` — a park exists for each, but none wrote its failing source form down, so each rule rests on a veto no later lane can reproduce. Only InitControls reaches the Mandatory-policy bar, and it does so through the DISJUNCTION's second branch (law-backed-source-unreachable, via claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source cited in its closing record's laws_applied) rather than through probed_form. TWO METHOD NOTES FOR WHOEVER EXTENDS THIS. Provenance must scan the WHOLE record history including superseded records: classing only against a brief's live attempts reported 'attempts-but-no-park' for InitControls and MtapOpenPort, because a rule's source-exhaustion evidence characteristically sits in the very park the rule then superseded. And the bar is a DISJUNCTION — an implementation checking only probed_form flags the best-evidenced, law-backed rules as unprovenanced, which inverts the ranking it exists to produce.
